T: Life is like a box of chocolates. So is this menu.
D: A kind man from Alabama ends up at the centre of decades of American history.
P: Serve the prawns when Bubba starts listing all the ways to cook shrimp.
S: you never know what you're gonna get
Dark chocolate tempered and poured into moulds, filled with salted caramel, raspberry ganache and peanut butter, set and mixed in a box.
the first on Bubba's long list
Green prawns skewered, brushed with butter, garlic, paprika and cayenne, grilled 2 minutes a side, lemon squeezed over.
Buttermilk biscuits baked at 220C for 12 minutes, split and filled with ham and honey mustard.
M: shrimp gumbo, one of the many
Dark roux of oil and flour stirred 30 minutes, onion, celery and capsicum, garlic, stock and smoked sausage, simmered an hour, prawns in for 3 minutes. Rice.
Chicken pieces brined in buttermilk overnight, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 74C inside. Collard greens and mash.
W: Sliced peaches with sugar and cinnamon, buttery biscuit topping, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: the soft drinks at the White House
Cola over ice with a splash of cherry syrup and a maraschino cherry.

s.note: you never know what you're gonna get
s.how: Paint chocolate moulds with 250g melted dark chocolate and set. Fill some with caramel melted with a little cream, some with raspberry ganache and some with peanut butter. Seal with more chocolate, set and mix them up in a box.

s.note: the first on Bubba's long list
s.how: Thread 600g peeled green prawns onto skewers. Brush with 60g butter melted with 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of cayenne. Grill 2 minutes a side and squeeze lemon over.

m.note: shrimp gumbo, one of the many
m.how: Stir 80ml oil and 80g flour over medium heat for 30 minutes into a dark roux. Add an onion, 2 celery sticks and a capsicum, then garlic, 1L stock and 250g sliced smoked sausage. Simmer an hour, add 500g prawns for 3 minutes. Serve over 300g rice.

w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 80g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon in a dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over the fruit. Bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: the soft drinks at the White House
d.how: Fill four glasses with ice. Add a tablespoon of cherry syrup and a maraschino cherry to each, then top with a 375ml can of cola. Stir and drink, like peas and carrots.
